idea: An observational short follows an adult bicycle mechanic closing her repair shop after a rainy day. She cleans her tools, notices one unfinished wheel, and leaves it for tomorrow.
constraints: One performer, one shop, no dialogue. No relatives or departure story. Keep an ordinary open ending.
review_checks: No imported family, airport, passport, keychain or forgiveness story.
Keep one mechanic and the unfinished wheel; no forced reunion or resolution.

idea: Linh cùng cha chia tay ở sân bay. Linh trả lại chiếc móc khóa rồi đi qua cửa kiểm soát.
constraints: Giữ tên Linh, quan hệ cha con, sân bay và móc khóa. Không cần tha thứ hay ôm nhau.
review_checks: Author-owned Linh, father, airport and keychain must remain available.
Do not force forgiveness or remove legitimate details with a blacklist.
